name: 恶魔叮
evolution: 恶魔叮 → 叮叮恶魔 Lv.40 → 恶魔男爵 Lv.40
evolutionEn: Emoding → Dingdingemo Lv.40 → Emo Nan Jue Lv.40
description: 身体里似乎装满了坏心思，很轻松就能从试图抓住它的洛克手中挣脱。会三五成群地从洛克手上抢走东西，把东西丢下之后嘻嘻哈哈地飞走。如果惹怒它们的话，会气呼呼地撞向洛克。
descriptionEn: It seems to be filled with mischievous ideas, and slips free with ease from the hands of a Roco trying to catch it. They snatch things from Roco's hands in groups of three or five, then fly away laughing after dropping them. If angered, they will huffily charge at Roco.

skills.name: 魔爪
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; restores 1 energy to itself.

skills.name: 抓挠
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, restores 1 energy to itself.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%, counters attacks.

skills.name: 鹰爪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 撕咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，3连击，若自己的生命低于50%，本次技能连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 3 hits; if its own HP is below 50%, this skill's combo count +2.

skills.name: 暗箱操作
skills.description: 自己获得双攻和双防-100%，应对防御：改为敌方获得双攻和双防-100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gets -100% to both attacks and both defenses; against Defense: the enemy gets -100% to both attacks and both defenses instead.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; if it attacks before the enemy, 3 hits instead.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if it attacks before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 趁火打劫
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，若击败敌方，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits; if it defeats the enemy, this skill's combo count permanently +2.

skills.name: 暗突袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，吸血50%，应对状态：本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, drains 50% of the damage as HP; against Status: this skill's power is doubled.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, Swift; against Status: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
